title: India and Pakistan, April to June 2025: a country note priced per fact
customer: A macro or commodities risk desk with South Asia exposure (rupee, cotton, shipping through Karachi) that must separate what happened from what was claimed before it moves a position.
note: Claims written the way a desk analyst would put them in a note. Observations are checked through Telegraph; forecasts are listed and not bought. c6 is fabricated on purpose (the failure case) and c4 is a claim the two governments contested.
